g.text: Prescriptions per 1,000 Medicaid enrollees (obesity_wz, FFSU + MCOU)
Orange = covering states (thin: each state; thick: cohort mean); gray = mean of never-treated states. Solid vertical line =
cohort's first treated quarter; dashed = coverage end; shaded = North Carolina's coverage gap.
Observed Wegovy/Zepbound prescriptions per 1,000 Medicaid enrollees in 2025 Q3: 27.7 in the 10
covering states (mean), 0.9 in the 34 never-treated states (mean)
Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment (warehouse marts).
